The '''Tomral Heavy Laser Cannon''' was a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] produced by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. It cost 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighed four [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]].
